meta.name: ulw-execute
meta.description: Execute a Prometheus work plan with Boulder state, evidence ledger updates, worktree discipline, parallel subagents, and Stop-hook continuation. Use after planning when the user says ulw-execute, execute plan, continue plan, resume plan, or asks to run a .omo/plans plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动执行开发计划，并行调度多个子代理
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果 你希望让代理按既定计划自动推进开发任务。
copy.tagline_en: Execute your development plan automatically while coordinating parallel subagents.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your agent to follow a defined plan and handle multiple subtasks in parallel.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会变成“总指挥”：它读取你选定的工作计划，把每个任务拆成小块，并派出多个“小助手”（子代理）并行干活。它自己不直接写代码，只负责分配任务、检查结果、记录进度，直到计划里的所有事项都完成。
howto.when: 当你说“ulw-execute”、“execute plan”、“continue plan”等关键词，或要求运行 .omo/plans 下的计划时触发。

say.text: ulw-execute，执行 .omo/plans 下的工作计划。
say.note: Claude 会挑选计划并开始委派子代理执行。

say.text: continue plan，接着上次没做完的进度继续干。
say.note: 会从上次中断处继续推进计划。

say.text: execute plan --make-pr，跑完帮我开个 PR。
say.note: 会以工作树方式执行并提交合并请求。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude acts as an orchestrator: it reads the chosen work plan, breaks tasks into small pieces, and dispatches multiple subagents to work in parallel. It does not write code itself; it delegates, checks results, and updates progress until all plan items are complete.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user says 'ulw-execute', 'execute plan', 'continue plan', or similar keywords, or asks to run a plan under .omo/plans.

say_en.text: ulw-execute, run the work plan under .omo/plans.
say_en.note: Claude will pick the plan and delegate execution to subagents.

say_en.text: continue plan, keep going from where we left off.
say_en.note: Resumes the plan from the last checkpoint.

say_en.text: execute plan --make-pr, open a PR when done.
say_en.note: Runs in worktree mode and delivers as a pull request.
